How to play

  • Tap a bottle, then tap another to pour. The whole connected top group of one color moves, as much as fits.
  • You can only pour into an empty bottle or onto the same top color, and the target needs space.
  • Sort every color into its own full bottle to win.
  • 🪄 Color Helper: makes one smart, valid pour for you (2 per level).
  • 💡 Hint shows the next good move. Undo restores everything.

❄ Frozen bottle: can’t pour or receive until it thaws (after 3 moves anywhere).

🔒 Locked bottle: opens with a 🔑. You earn one whenever you fill a bottle with a single color.
